message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
b=open('work/owner.rar','rb').read()
start=23+4 # pos at raw len byte
hdr=b[start:start+46]
for i,x in enumerate(hdr): print(i, f'{x:02x}', chr(x) if 32<=x<127 else '.')

def rv(data,i):
 r=0;s=0;st=i
 while True:
  v=data[i]; i+=1; r|=(v&0x7f)<<s
  if v<128: return r,i,i-st
  s+=7

i=1
for name in ['hid','flags','extra','data','file_flags','unpacked','file_attr','mtime','crc','comp','host','namesize']:
 if name in ['mtime','crc']:
  print(name, hdr[i:i+4].hex()); i+=4
 else:
  v,j,l=rv(hdr,i); print(name,v,l,'bytes',hdr[i:j].hex()); i=j
print('filename',hdr[i:i+8]); i+=8
print('extra starts',i, hdr[i:].hex(), len(hdr)-i)
# parse extra: extra_field_size, id, flags,name lengths
j=i
for name in ['extra_field_size','extra_field_id','owner_flags','user_len']:
 v,jj,l=rv(hdr,j); print(name,v,l,hdr[j:jj].hex()); j=jj
print('user',hdr[j:j+4]); j+=4
v,jj,l=rv(hdr,j); print('grp_len',v,l,hdr[j:jj].hex()); j=jj
print('grp',hdr[j:])
PY
